## Common Bat (CR 1/8)

**XP** 50  
N Diminutive animal  
**Init** +2; **Senses** blindsense 20 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +4 size)  
**hp** 6 (1d8–2)  
**Fort** +0, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2  


**Offense**


**Speed** 5 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)  
**Melee** bite +6 (1d3+3)*  
**Space** 1 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 1, **Dex** 15, **Con** 6, **Int** 2, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 5  
**Base Atk** +0; CMB—2; **CMD** 3  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Fly +16, Perception +6; **Racial Modifier** +4 Perception  


**Special Abilities**


**Familiar** The master of a bat familiar gains a +3 bonus on Fly checks.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate and hot forests and deserts  
**Organization** colony (10–400)  
**Treasure** none
